dataConsent.heroSubtitle: Connect your heart rate monitor to see exactly how meditation changes your body — in real time.
dataConsent.demoLabel: Live example — 8 min Box Breathing session
dataConsent.whatWeTrack: What we track during your session
dataConsent.hrDesc: We measure your heart rate before, during, and after each session. A drop of 10–30 bpm is a reliable sign your nervous system has shifted into rest mode.
dataConsent.hrExample: Your HR dropped from 88 to 64 bpm — a 27% reduction in 8 minutes
dataConsent.hrvDesc: HRV is the variation between heartbeats — a higher HRV means your body is calm and adaptable. It's the single best real-time indicator of stress reduction.
dataConsent.hrvExample: HRV improved from 42ms to 67ms — your recovery index is now optimal
dataConsent.calmDesc: We combine HR change, HRV improvement, and session duration into a single Calm Score. Track it over time to see your meditation practice get stronger.
dataConsent.calmExample: 7-day average Calm Score: +28. Up 40% from last week 🌊
dataConsent.aiDesc: Your biometrics tell us which techniques work best for you personally. If 4-7-8 consistently gives you a better Calm Score than Box Breathing, we'll recommend it more.
dataConsent.aiExample: Based on 14 sessions: 4-7-8 is 2.3× more effective for your nervous system
dataConsent.flowWatchDesc: Heart rate via Bluetooth LE — never leaves your device without permission
dataConsent.flowBrowserDesc: Processed locally first — we only send aggregated session summaries
dataConsent.flowServerDesc: Encrypted, stored under your account — never sold, never shared
dataConsent.flowAIDesc: Uses your patterns to improve recommendations — only accessible to you
dataConsent.privacy1: Your heart rate data is never sold to third parties
dataConsent.privacy2: You can delete all biometric data at any time from your profile
dataConsent.privacy3: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest
dataConsent.privacy4: We never share individual readings — only you see your data
dataConsent.privacy5: You can disconnect your device and revoke access at any time
dataConsent.privacy6: Breathe is not a medical device — this is for personal wellness only
dataConsent.consentText: I understand that Breathe will use my heart rate data to calculate my Calm Score and improve breathing recommendations. I can revoke this permission at any time.
dataConsent.skipLink: Skip for now — use Breathe without biometrics
